column2: Ah, yes. Well, um, she seems much better. No need to worry.
What!? No, well... Hey! Does anyone know what happened to those papers!? Sorry, {p}-kun! I'm busy right now!
Sorry, {p}-kun! I'm busy right now!
Rei Uryu's condo must be in Science City's off-limits area. Finding it should be the only way to learn where Maria is... Do your best!
I'm Dragon Panther-sama, Panther Claw's mightiest warrior! I won't let you run wild in this castle any longer!
We'll do it, we'll do it! We won't lose, we won't lose! Even if the foe's ten thousand strong, y'all!
Grazie, grazie! Been a while since I got to cut loose... I'm Macaroni, from Tottori Prefecture, Italy! You small fry can just vanish!

I am Kendo Sasaki.

I crossed countless ages from the Warring States era to come to this time, and at last my hour of battle has come...

I came to this time to cut you down!!
We Reptilians will do everything in our power to destroy Getter Robo!
Clothes? Don't need 'em.\n\nThey told me to wrap myself up in the bandages that didn't sell, see.
Hahaha! Folks think I'm a mummy monster, but really I'm just a regular guy.
My big sis hates bandages, so she wears the sticking plasters that didn't sell.

I am Juzo Kabuto, a scientist who builds robots. I hear that after my death, many robots were born. Among them, I hear, is one built on an energy found through space research: a magic light where a mere trace gives enormous power... Getter Rays! Wahahaha! I'd love to see it!

I am Juzo Kabuto, a scientist who builds robots. The Demon God I left behind as I died is something else! It can become a god and save mankind, or become a devil and destroy the world! The choice is yours!! It will do whatever you wish!
This game really makes the impossible possible, don'tcha think? And why is it so easy to make it possible? 'Cause this game is slapdash, that's why!
I curse myself...\n\nPlunging all mankind into the depths of suffering, creating hell on Earth... That must never be allowed to happen.
This academy is mine, you might say. There's nothing here that doesn't go my way!
Ahaha, somehow business is lousy again today. What's goin' on, I wonder?
Even at school, I don't sit on no chair. I can't settle down unless I'm sittin' on my straw mat.
From those eyes all wet with tears, Omorai-kun felt somethin'! Somethin' that sinks into your heart! Somethin' that sinks right in! To answer that, I'm goin'!! That's Omorai's manly spirit!!
Sure is warm... Sunbathin's the best.
It was so hot, I went for a swim in the pond nearby. And ever since, for some reason, the tap water tastes just how I like it.
So you're the intruder? Don't think you can escape from here. I, Tomahawk Panther, will cut you in two!
I am Scissors Panther.\n\nHeh heh heh... What's wrong, you look pale? If you won't come at me, I'll come at you!!
My name is Zennon, Zennon the Demon King!! Hear me, humans!!\n\nThe Demon army will launch its attack on the whole world. Humans, feel the might of the Earth's true rulers!!
Our attack will not stop until every last human is dead.\n\nYou, and you, and you will die!!
Have you forgotten...? World conquest is Dr. Hell's dream. Let's test whether you're truly a hindrance. Come, Count Brocken!
Yes, sir!
Ngh! ...Grr, curse you!
Wahahaha...! Not bad at all! But that's enough for now.\n\nWe'll continue this when we next meet as enemies...!
THAT will be the true battle! It won't go like today!
Wahahahahaha...!!
I hear there's an island of devils far to the northwest. A terrible island no one returns from alive.
They say Dr. Hell's Saluud is at an island to the northwest. And there's these funky machines called Mechanical Beasts there. Whaddaya say we go take a gander!
What are you doing?
Um... well... *GRRRROWL*!
Oh, you're hungry!
Iyahaya... nantomo...
Heh heh! Thanks!
I've seen this kid!\n\nHe's the Gongane Academy student who was supposed to make the Block A final in the tournament!
Huh? Is that true?
Iyahaya... nantomo...
Yeah... Nantomo Iyahaya!
Huh. I'm {p}! Nice to meet you, Nantomo-kun!
Iyahaya... nantomo...
Ah, Sayoko-san!
Nantomo-kun, help! Koja Hatesate is after me!
Found you, Sayoko Iyahaya, Nantomo Iyahaya! The Hatesate family controls Japan's economy! The Iyahayas should step aside!
Nantomo-kun, help!
Iyahaya... nantomo...
Um, Nantomo-kun...?
This woman's good!\n\n{p}! Let's take her on!
Whaaat!?
Thank you! You saved me! The Hatesate family is always out to get the Iyahayas. Upstart nouveau riche are so tiresome!
By the way, are you a Gongane Academy student?
No, I'm...
My! Did you hear that, Nantomo-kun?
Iyahaya, nantomo... What a strange story!
I've decided!
Nantomo-kun, let's help {p} and the others! I don't know what's going on,\n\nbut the Iyahaya fortune will surely solve it!
After all, there's nothing the Iyahayas can't do! Ohohoho!
They say some odd kid snuck into the doghouse east of town. A kid nobody's seen before... Where'd he come from?
The devil statue that shows the history of the Demons... What on earth did Ryo-kun and Akira-kun see...?
The devil statue will show you nothing.
I am Psycho Jenny. I dwell here with this statue.
A-a Demon!?
That's right. I am of the Demon race. I have come to fetch you.
To help you remember what you've forgotten!
Whoaaa!
Well?\n\nHave you remembered anything about the Demon King, about the Dimension Chain?
...I-I don't know.
I see...\n\nThen I shall go with you.
By going with you, I can learn stronger methods of psychic attack. Have you forgotten? The Demons are a warrior race that always seeks to grow stronger!
What's going on with the world? Black fiends... giant girls?
I was attacked by a black fiend and a girl saved me! But that girl, cute face and all, was a giantess over three meters tall!
She said beating black fiends doesn't pay one bit... She's a hunter of villains, apparently! The girl? She went that way.
A giant body and a brain that'd put a university professor to shame! And they say she's only in sixth grade! The girl? Looks like she went over there.
Kyaaa!
Thank you so much!
What!? An earthquake...? It's a weird kind of shaking...
Huh? It stopped.
Did you beat the black fiend?
Whoa! Wh-who are you?
I'm Daiko Hoin, villain hunter!
Villain hunter?
For justice! I capture villains who do harm to the world. In today's world, the super-A-class villains are the black fiends! That's what I think!
So that's why you were saving the townspeople from the black fiends.
That's right. By the way, who are you?
I'm {p}! Actually, I...
So you're the one the Demon King is after... But I don't like the Demon King's methods! I'll lend you a hand! We'll fight together!
Wh-what's HE doing here!?
Huh? Hey hey, thanks for the other day! This here's my classmate, Danshi Otoko!
